notes.title: HUGE Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42452511/35a4a8a6722aa4950fa7956b7d572b76a926aea5.png[/img]

[h2][b]This is new: [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] WOW! Check out all the new animals of the Banana Drama universe:
[*] Bear, Rhino, Giraffe, Tiger, Alpaca, Deer, Lion, Cow & Cockatoo - Thanks to @Neofy for modeling all new animals. Show him some appreciation on our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/FpYd9eSfme]here[/url]
[*] Some of the animals are free to play and some of them cost a little bit of money, we have development costs to cover, but we want Banana Drama to be playable for everyone - so no costs on the game itself and no pay to win <3
[*] Check out all new animal DLCs [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/2000150/Banana_Drama/]here [/url]
[*] Strategic upgrade! There are three different army types now: Balanced, Offensive and Defensive
[*] Banana Drama has a new beta "Sandbox" game mode, try it out!
[*] In Sanbox mode, it is possible to create up to 999 monkeys now, but make sure you don't overload your PC by checking our minimum system requirements ;)
[*] Oh and now you are able to choose between three bot-difficulties when playing with bots!
[*] Bot patch: The bots are smarter now!
[*] Many game design changes. More beauty for the soul and simplicity :) 
[*] New animations for all animals
[*] We added some fresh music
[*] We improved the game’s performance
[*] We prepared the menu for an upcoming campaign mode, stay tuned!
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The warrior monkey laser sometimes did not disappear 
[*] Exception fixes
[*] Bots did not attack team blue in single player mode
[*] Shooter could not attack further when hitting undestroyable objects
[*] Kings of bots did not appear in single player mode
[/list]

[h2][b]DLC animals overview: [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Helicopter giraffe![/b] Get the incredibly excited Banana Drama giraffe with this DLC. She has incredible balanced capabilities and is one of the best allrounders of all Banana Drama animals ("balanced" type). Sometimes she gets so excited that she can't stop spinning her head like a helicopter. Let's hope she doesn't fly away!

[*] Wow a[b] tiger[/b]! Get the incredibly cute and sleepy Banana Drama tiger with this DLC. He has incredible balanced capabilities and is one of the best allrounders of all Banana Drama animals ("balanced" type). He is particularly proud of his beautiful coat and regularly impresses many female tigers with it.

[*] [b]Alpapaca![/b] Get the incredibly fluffy Banana Drama alpaca with this DLC. He has incredible balanced capabilities and is one of the best allrounders of all Banana Drama aimals ("balanced" type). Unfortunately, he is allergic to bananas and therefore often sneezes - he would like to point out that his sneezing is often mistaken for spitting. Please keep this in mind.

[*] Fly [b]cockatoo[/b]! Get the incredibly agile Banana Drama cockatoo with this DLC. He has incredible offensive capabilities and is able to run/fly faster than others ("strong offense" type). Similar to his best friend "Kiki the cockatoo" his abilities are often underestimated due to his cute looks!

[*] Roaarrrr - the [b]Lion[/b]! Get the incredibly proud Banana Drama lion with this DLC. He has incredible offensive capabilities and is able to run faster than others. A lion throwing bananas is a little unusual at first glance, but he has learnt this effective fighting technique from the monke(y)s!

[*] [b]Cow[/b] (moo)! Get the incredibly sassy Banana Drama cow with this DLC. The cow has incredible defensive capabilities and is able to collect resources faster than others ("strong defense" type). The cow is very self-confident and often likes to show off its beautiful udder!

[*] Oh [b]deer[/b]! Get the incredible shy Banana Drama deer with this DLC. He has incredible defensive capabilities and is able to collect resources faster than others ("strong defense" type). It's lucky that there are no roads or cars in Banana Drama, because that would be fatal for the deer! 
[/list]

Check out all new animal DLCs [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/2000150/Banana_Drama/]here[/url]. Join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/FpYd9eSfme]here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42452511/a4972c1d3da23322fc0151636bc3c770027d95c5.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Banana Drama and thanks for your support!

notes.title: TOURNAMENT?! Yes!
notes.content:
Are you the best Banana Drama gamer in the community? :bananaYellow:  This is your chance to find out!
It takes place on October 30th at 7pm UTC ⏰
If you don’t want to participate you’re welcome, too! The games will be streamed on discord!

 ℹ️  Info:

- Four online games & one final game (with the winners of the first four games)
- Game mode: Destroy the headquarters
- You have to stream your game during the match (please do not publish confidential information)
- Developers are not included in the scoring if they take part
- Please check the time in your country as 7pm is the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

 🔥 Prize:

- 1st prize: You will get the upcoming Gold DLC for free & the “Tournament-Champ” discord role 
- 2nd prize: You will get the upcoming Silver DLC for free & the “Tournament-Finalist” discord role
- 3rd prize: You will get the upcoming Bronze DLC for free  & the “Tournament-Finalist” discord role
- 4th prize:  You will get the “Tournament-Finalist” discord role

 ❔ How:

- Send a private message to @Dommenuss on DISCORD [url=https://discord.gg/FpYd9eSfme](here)[/url] until October 28th that you want to take part.
- If possible send your PC specifications & your average internet speed. 
- We will get back to you as soon as possible 🙂 

First come, first served!
See you!

notes.title: Banana Drama Update
notes.content:
What’s new:
[list]
[*] NEW game mode: destroy the headquarters of your enemies!!! You can switch between the new and the old game mode
[*] Now there is a sound volume and a music volume slider within the ingame settings menu to give you full sound control
[*] You can now rotate the blueprints by scrolling the mouse wheel
[*] The AI is attacking more frequently - be aware! 
[*] Press ctrl+A or cmd+A to select all your monkeys
[*] Now it is possible to double click on a monkey to select all monkeys in a specific range
[*] The color of the selection rectangle now depends on the player’s color
[*] The statistics screen looks nicer
[*] The gates can be erased and are vulnerable in their open state
[*] Design updates
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] An error was caused at the market when a monkey, that is already standing at the market, is assigned to go to the market again
[*] An error was caused at the market when monkeys switch between markets
[*] An error occurred which prevented the red & green bots from attacking during a singleplayer game
[*] The bots are not throwing bananas over a long distance anymore
[*] Sometimes the bots bananas exploded at themselves
[*] Health bar wasn't culled with distance
[/list]

Btw: Be part of the banana crew on discord!

notes.title: Banana Drama Update
notes.content:
What’s new:
[list]
[*] Now you get a reward for destroying an opponent's bungalow, yey!
[*] If you are inactive (on the toilet, making hot dogs etc.) Banana Drama now gives you twice as much time before you are thrown out of the session
[*] You can now wait longer for your friends within a lobby. Timeout increased to 7 minutes
[*] If you have a potato PC, you will no longer be automatically set to "very low" when playing in singleplayer mode
[*] “Ultra” is nicer to look at 
[*] Catapults do not attack your own fences & gates any more
[*] Fences are not converting into gates immediately - hold to build
[*] Objects can not be pasted any more if dinos are really close
[*] Gates can only be built if your own monkeys are nearby and no enemies are in range
[*] When you rotate the camera and a blueprint is active it does not rotate any longer
[*] We made some minor naming & design changes
[*] We improved the games performance significantly
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] It is not possible to put more than 12 monkeys at a tree any more
[*] Monkeys are not able to start an activity from any distance any more
[*] Dinos do stop spitting after destroying a gate now
[*] The loading screen should look better
[/list]

notes.title: Banana Drama Update
notes.content:
[b]What is new:[/b]
[list]
[*] in building mode the blueprints can be rotated by the key Q
[*] you can type in the desired number of resources you want to trade on the marketplace
[*] the monkey kings are bigger now
[*] the collection speed of resources was increased
[*] gifts appear less frequently in 1-player mode
[*] the catapult blueprint now has a circle that indicates the attack range
[*] minor design updates
[/list]
[b]Some minor bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] enemies standing in gates can now be attacked
[*] you’ll get a notification if you have no bananas or stones while attacking
[*] actual silver banana upgrade costs match with the stated costs
[*] in multiplayer mode your steam name will be filled in automatically
[/list]
